title: Featured place
description: A place shown as a one-tap button on the home page. Cameras are never attached to a place; results come from distance.

radius_miles.description: Default search radius for this place.

order.description: Lower numbers first. Popular places can go first later.

collection.description: Id of a collection (data/collections) this place belongs to. Places in a collection are listed there instead of on the main home list.

include_kinds.description: Ferry, airport or border reports to show for this place even though it is not in that collection (for example the Mukilteo ferry town).

note.description: A short note shown above the results, e.g. why there are no cameras yet.

snow_report_url.description: Ski areas: the resort's own snow report (or mountain report) page, linked from the place page.

link.description: A small link out, e.g. to the resort's own camera page.

camera_tags.description: If set, this place lists only cameras that carry one of these tags (for a themed place such as scenic views) instead of every camera within its radius.

weather_radius_miles.description: How far to look for weather reports, when that should be smaller than radius_miles (used by wide themed places).

state.description: The state this place is in, used to group the places directory. Defaults to Washington.
